1. Scope — Covers the requirements of rubber-capped mallet used in orthopaedic and general 
surgery. 

2. Material 

2.1 The mallet head shall be manufactured from carbon steel conforming to Designation T70 of 
Schedule VI of IS : 1570-1961*. 

2.2 The handle of the mallet shall be made of aluminium alloy of Designation NF 3 of IS: 734-19671. 

2.3 The pin shall be made from stainless steel conforming to Designation 22Cr13 of Schedule V of 
13:1570-1961*. 

2.4 The rubber used for the mallet head shall be unaffected by acid and grease and shall withstand the 
sterilizing temperature. It shall also conform to Type B Grade 4 of IS: 5192-1969t. 

3. Shape and Dimensions — As shown in Fig. 1.

3.1 The weight of the hammer head shall be 335 g with a tolerance of ±5 percent. 

4. Workmanship and Finish—The mallet shall be well shaped and free from cracks, seams, 
fins, burrs and other surface flaws. The mallet shail.be finished smooth all over and all sharp edges shall 
be removed. The handle shall be fitted to the head through a dowel pin as shown in Fig. 1. The 
mallet shall be plated chromium over nickel and the plating shall conform to Service Grade No. 2 of 
IS : 1068-1968§. 

4.2 Heat Treatment — The head of the mallet shall bo hardened and tempered to give a hardness of 
450 to 550 WV.

S. Packing — As agreed to between the purchaser and the supplier.
